Community Highlights

Society of Cutaneous Oncology

Community Highlights

A record of the people who keep showing up: clinicians, researchers, trainees, and collaborators who have contributed their time to SoCO Journal Clubs and Research Forums.

A note on the archive. Attendance records are available for a recent subset of SoCO meetings rather than the full history of the community. Everything on this page therefore refers to tracked meetings only.

The tracked community

Showing up matters.

The numbers below are not meant to turn participation into a competition. They are a simple way to recognize the people who have repeatedly made time for thoughtful, multidisciplinary discussion.

Academic–industry participation

Industry collaborators

Industry colleagues are recognized separately rather than included in the academic / clinical participation ranking. Company assignment is based primarily on email domain, with a small person-level override table embedded directly in this page for older attendance exports whose email was not captured. Known colleagues who participated from shared rooms—or whose participation is confirmed from historical meeting correspondence when the Teams attendance export is no longer available—are also acknowledged without assigning invented attendance minutes.
